text:
ashley (sec-eng): DAST flagged a high-sev auth bypass on /auth/callback in staging. reproduction in report shows a 302->200 flow that creates a session with forged state. anyone else seeing this?

sam (backend): saw the alert earlier. we made a keystore RBAC change yesterday to let the scan runner read a test key; wondering if that widened privileges.

ashley (sec-eng): @sam the binding was `scanner-read` -> `roles/keystore.viewer` granted to principal scan-runner@infra at ~11:03.

sam (backend): yep that was me for the staging test fixture. intended to scope to staging but may have hit the preview callback. i tightened the binding at 12:10 but DAST might have hit during the window.

kevin (infra): quick audit cmd to confirm the change: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.project_id="redwood-staging"' --freshness=2h` will show the actor and time.

mike (oncall): pages show 403s from preview cluster to keystore since ~11:05, matching the timeline.

ashley (sec-eng): sec-bot uploaded the DAST report: https://dast.internal/reports/4922223333 1. repro step: `POST /auth/callback?state=...` with forged state header. session created for unauthenticated subject.

sam (backend): sounds like two issues: 1) scanner service account accidentally granted keystore viewer, 2) callback code accepts `state` in test-mode sessions.

ashley (sec-eng): immediate asks: revoke scanner binding, rotate the ephemeral key used by the runner, and preserve audit logs for IR.

kevin (infra): revoked binding at 12:30 and kicked off KMS rotation job `rot-job-2024-4922`. rotation id `rot-4922`. command used: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr/staging-key`

mike (oncall): silencing preview cluster pages and copying timeline to incidents. if repro still works after revocation, escalate as application vuln.

ashley (sec-eng): @sam can you run a canary from an external IP with this curl and confirm we get 401 or 302, not 200?

curl -v -X POST 'https://staging.redwood/api/auth/callback' -d 'state=fake' -H 'Cookie: _session=none'

sam (backend): canary result at 12:45: `2024-05-14T12:45:12Z auth: callback rejected principal=unknown -> 401`. looks like revocation mitigated it. i'll run full suite in 10m.

ashley (sec-eng): follow-ups: 1) add a PR checklist gating any RBAC changes (include expiry and scope) 2) update scanner runbooks to request ephemeral grants via `scanner-orchestrator` 3) persist DAST evidence into the IR ticket for reproducibility.

kevin (infra): will change audit retention hooks: forward keystore IAM events to sec S3 bucket for 90d (was 30d). PR incoming.

sec-bot: automated note - ticket created INC-2024-234, severity P2, attached DAST report and SetIamPolicy audit entries.

mike (oncall): marking paging resolved; triage remains open until IR checklist done. :white_check_mark: 

ashley (sec-eng): i'll file a short postmortem focusing on the human step (scoped RBAC change without expiry) and the tooling gap. assigning action items in the ticket. thanks all. :pray:
